summary: UGI Corp filed a Form 8-K regarding its indirect subsidiaries' issuance of $500 million aggregate principal amount of 6.875% senior unsecured notes due 2031. The notes were issued by AmeriGas Partners and AmeriGas Finance Corp in a private offering to qualified institutional buyers under Rule 144A and to non-U.S. persons under Regulation S. Terms include semi-annual interest payments, optional redemption provisions with a make-whole premium prior to June 1, 2028, and a declining call premium thereafter, plus a 40% equity clawback provision. No special situation; this is a routine debt financing event.
